title: NPDev verification panel
description: npdev-verification-panel.v1: one JSON document describing an inventory of verification items (gates, check-scripts, test-suites, probes, acceptance scenarios, browser routines, workflows) and the last known run of each. Two producers emit it (the NPDev repo itself via `npdev verify --panel`; a generated app via its emitted verification page); one renderer consumes it. See PLAN 2026-08-27 S1. The Kanban column is DERIVED by the renderer, never stored in this document.

name.description: Repo name for an npdev-repo, or the app's namespace for a generated-app.

root.description: Absolute filesystem root of the subject (repo root, or the app dir). Null when not a file-backed subject.

commit.description: Current HEAD sha for an npdev-repo; null for a generated app with no git.

name.description: Human label for the first column.

command.description: The concrete command that re-runs this item, for the Run button. Null when the panel cannot re-run it (and runnable must then be false).

runnable.description: false => the renderer shows no Run control.

maxStaleness.description: Threshold label from STALENESS_TO_TIMEDELTA (scripts/quality/cadence_state.py). Drives the STALE column; must stay a member of that vocabulary. Null when staleness does not apply.

durationSeconds.description: Wall-clock duration of this run, when the caller measured it.

commit.description: Commit this run executed against, when known.

reportPath.description: Where the run wrote its machine-readable report, when any. Rendered as a 'View report' link.

logPath.description: Where the run wrote its log, when any.

typicalDurationSeconds.description: Percentiles computed from the run history, only once >= 3 samples exist. null until then -- never synthesise a range from a single run.
